notes.title: Bearly Escape - June Update is Here! 🐾
notes.content: [p]Hey Rescuers,[/p][p]We’ve got a claw-some new update packed with [b]crazy machines[/b] and [b]smoother, wilder gameplay[/b]!🧸[/p][p]✨ 2 new claw machine modes – shake it or use a magic wand![/p][p]✨ Use a magic wand to float and catch plushies mid-air[/p][p]✨ 3 brand-new levels added – more fun, more chaos![/p][p]✨ Launch the bear from giant cannons to leap over traps[/p][p]✨ Faster pace, better visuals, and upgraded animations![/p][p]🎯Stay tuned – more levels (up to 12!) and an epic final showdown are [b]coming late July[/b]![/p]
